task.description:
Implement DSL-08 (Function Purity). The built-in functions are already implemented in src/expr/mod.zig and are already pure. The main work is adding determinism verification tests.

From the design artefact at src/design/dsl-08-function-purity.md:

1. Add a `testDeterminism` helper function and `expectValueEq` helper in src/expr/mod.zig (in the test block)
2. Add 24 determinism tests for all pure built-in functions (see test matrix in the design artefact — rows 1-24)
3. Add 1 type/range test for now() (row 25 — tests that it returns a timestamp in a reasonable range, not determinism)
4. Ensure purity contract documentation is present in the module doc comment (already says "No I/O. No DB access. Pure functions.")
5. Verify the now() exemption comment is present in the func_call dispatch

The design artefact provides the exact code for:
- testDeterminism() helper
- expectValueEq() helper
- The full test matrix (25 tests covering all pure built-ins)

Also verify branch is feature/WF02-dsl08-20260527 before starting.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test exits 0 with all DSL-08 tests passing
24 determinism tests exist for pure built-in functions (call twice, compare outputs)
Error-set validation: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' produces no output
All helper functions use provided allocator parameter
No I/O in test helper functions

result.summary: Implemented DSL-08 function purity contract: added testDeterminism() and expectValueEq() helper functions plus 24 determinism tests and 1 now() type/range test. zig build, zig build test (187 pass, 0 leaks), error-set validation all pass.
